name: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program
region: Africa-wide (partner universities in Africa, Canada, US, UK)
summary: Funds academically talented young people, with a focus on economically disadvantaged students and leadership potential, through a network of partner universities including ALU.

name: Chevening Scholarships
summary: UK government's global scholarship program for one-year master's degrees in the UK, aimed at emerging leaders with strong academic backgrounds and leadership experience.

name: DAAD Scholarships
field: All fields, strong in engineering & sciences
summary: Germany's national scholarship agency offering a wide range of programmes for study or research in Germany, many targeted at students from developing countries.

name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
summary: Flagship U.S. government exchange program funding graduate study, research, and professional development in the United States for international students.

name: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
provider: Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation / University of Cambridge
cycle: Annual, typically closes in the year prior to entry
summary: Highly competitive full-cost scholarship for outstanding applicants from outside the UK to pursue a full-time postgraduate degree at the University of Cambridge.

name: Schwarzman Scholars
field: Public policy, economics & business, international studies
summary: One-year master's program at Tsinghua University in Beijing preparing future leaders to understand global affairs and China's role in the world.

name: MEXT Scholarship
cycle: Annual, typically via local Japanese embassy
summary: Japanese government scholarship covering tuition, a monthly stipend, and airfare for international students to study at Japanese universities.

name: Aga Khan Foundation International Scholarship Programme
summary: Need-blind, merit-based scholarships for outstanding students from select developing countries with no other means of financing graduate study.

name: African Leadership Academy Network Scholarships
summary: Network of scholarships connected to African Leadership Academy and affiliated institutions (including ALU) supporting African students pursuing higher education.

name: Rhodes Scholarship
summary: One of the oldest international graduate scholarships, funding study at the University of Oxford for exceptional students selected on academic merit and character.
